hub_identity.reservation_rule: Reserve the ticket (atomic O_EXCL create) before writing runners, artifacts, data, or logs. Existing IDs are rejected across registry, JSONL, tickets, logs, artifacts, data, and runners.

hypothesis: candidate_pool: after the accepted SBC expense burden source, a material decline in unrecognized nonvested award compensation cost backlog relative to revenue may identify future dilution-cost relief when revenue/gross-profit health and liquid SPY-relative price confirmation are present.

prediction.confidence_reason: The playbook forbids nearby SBC threshold retunes but explicitly names grant-value normalization as valid new evidence. The local raw SEC Companyfacts cache exposes unrecognized nonvested award cost tags, but the item is instant/quarterly and may mostly capture normal vesting decay rather than a tradable future dilution relief edge.

execution_envelope.liquidity_source: price >= $10 and ADV20 >= $50M from PIT OHLCV
execution_envelope.order_semantics: observe-only next-session-open paper entry; no broker order
execution_envelope.portfolio_displacement: none unless a later shared helper and activation gate pass
execution_envelope.kill_switch: trade_enabled remains false; no production adapter changes
execution_envelope.failure_handling: missing raw SEC unrecognized nonvested SBC award cost backlog, missing annual revenue or gross-profit normalizer, missing prior backlog comparison point, stale facts, missing CIK mapping, missing OHLCV, missing next open, or missing 10d exit rejects the paper candidate

production_impact.parity_note: This experiment changes no production code. A positive result is only a replay lead until a shared default-off helper computes the same raw SEC instant grant-value backlog tag mapping, filed-date PIT annual revenue/gross-profit normalization, liquid SPY-relative confirmation, cooldown, next-open paper entry, 10-day exit, costs, and concentration controls in both historical replay and daily production.

post_run_reflection.why_result_happened: The SBC grant-value backlog relief source had positive aggregate EV/PnL, but did not clear Gate 4 because the effect was narrow and unstable: old_thin regressed -0.0278 EV and $-1,091.19, while positive PnL was dominated by too few names (max single positive share 84.87%, HHI 0.7432). It also failed the accepted distribution and accepted SBC comparators, so the unrecognized backlog decline is more likely capturing sparse seasonal vesting decay in already-strong growth names than a robust incremental dilution-quality edge. Do not promote or tune this fixed grant-value normalization bundle on the same frozen windows.
post_run_reflection.outcome_summary: Aggregate EV delta +0.2356; aggregate PnL delta $+3,405.92; max drawdown drift +0.0036; 34 paper trades.
post_run_reflection.forbidden_near_neighbor_retry: Do not retry by sweeping grant backlog tag lists, backlog/revenue thresholds, improvement percentage, fact freshness, period gap, annual revenue/gross-profit floors, RS/close/volume/vol guards, top-N, hold days, cooldown, or notional on these frozen windows.
post_run_reflection.new_evidence_required: A retry needs materially different PIT grant-value evidence such as closed forward replacement-value rows, option-exercise/vesting context joined to the same issuers, or a production-shared daily snapshot of grant backlog maturation. Do not sweep grant backlog tags, freshness, ratio thresholds, RS/close/volume guards, top-N, hold, cooldown, or notional on these frozen windows.
